name: Shikishima Kururu
source:
Krile “Kururu” Shikishima is a lycan loli and an academic genius. She is so damn smart that she has already skipped several grades. Krile loves to read books and she is currently the head of the library committee. She is also proficient in magic and she can prove it with Azu, her talking stuffed cat. Azu speaks like some kind of gang boss and loves to order Shizuma around even though it can’t really do anything. Krile responds to Azu’s wild yammerings with sudden acts of violence, leading it to squeal and scream while begging for mercy. They certainly are…a unique duo. Because she is always surrounded by others older than her, she develops a hidden desire to grow up quickly. If Shizuma captures her heart, her desire strengthens, wishing to be seen as a woman in his eyes. In a world where magic exists, that possibility can become a reality.

[Edited from [url=http://verbalrubbish.oniichannoecchi.com/?p=374]m3rryweather's review[/url].]
